values.meaning: Physical Damage (Cunning Sweep, inner cone hit)
values.binNote: The wiki's non-doubled (inner-hit) numbers are exactly half of the outer-hit/'Increased' row (Damage_1_Base=40..120, BAD_Ratio=0.6, Percent=0.04..0.06, and the 3%-per-100-AD scaling in Calc_Damage_1_Percent_Max's 0.0003 AD coefficient), consistent with Damage_1_Min_Ratio=0.5 halving that row. The bin has no separate data row storing the halved 20-60/0.3/0.0075 numbers directly; they are derived by applying Min_Ratio to Calc_Damage_1_Max/Calc_Damage_1_Percent_Max.

values.quote: '''Ambessa''' can cast ''{{ai|Sundering Slam|Ambessa}}'' within the next 4 seconds

mechanics.claim: Ambessa enters a 0.225-second lockout before the slash/slam lands, and the ability's damage is dealt only when the lockout ends.
mechanics.quote: enters a {{fd|0.225}}-second {{tip|lockout}}, at the end of which she slashes with her twin drakehounds

mechanics.claim: Cunning Sweep deals doubled damage to enemies caught by the outer edge of the cone.
mechanics.quote: The damage is {{ccs|doubled|physical}} against enemies hit by the outer edge.

mechanics.claim: Sundering Slam deals doubled damage to the first enemy hit by the line.
mechanics.quote: The damage is {{ccs|doubled|physical}} against the first enemy hit.

mechanics.claim: Landing Cunning Sweep on at least one enemy grants a 4-second window to cast Sundering Slam as a follow-up.
mechanics.quote: If this hits at least one enemy, '''Ambessa''' can cast ''{{ai|Sundering Slam|Ambessa}}'' within the next 4 seconds.

mechanics.claim: Against monsters, the ability deals a flat 75 bonus physical damage and its health-ratio damage is capped at a level-scaling value.
mechanics.quote: ''Cunning Sweep'' deals {{as|75 '''bonus''' physical damage}} and the damage based on their health ratio is capped at {{pplevel|100 to 300}}.
